claim_one_line: THE PAPER'S RELATED-WORK ARMOR: FIVE DIFFERENTIATORS, EACH ENDING IN WHAT WE DO NOT CLAIM. Lane 6 of the owner-routed websearch package. THE ORGANIZING FACT: our strongest defence is our own price ledger -- every neighbouring programme is attacked precisely where it claims to DERIVE something it in fact CHOSE, while our chain states its inputs (B1017's five; one unit, two bits, one orbit-point) and its no-go (C17: zero of 24 SM parameters reduced, the wall stands) BEFORE a referee raises it. (1) LISI E8: Distler-Garibaldi arXiv:0905.2658 Theorem 1.3 proves NO chiral gauge theory arises from any ToE subgroup of E8 in real or complex form, not even one generation, via mirror fermions. We use E6 with a complex 27 -- but the load-bearing difference is the ACCOUNTING: chirality is a PRICED INPUT, F_2 bit B, banked as NOT self-supplied (B1017/B582). D-G proved an exceptional algebra cannot hand you chirality; our ledger already pays for it. We do NOT claim a single exceptional Lie algebra DERIVES chiral fermions or three generations. (2) FUREY: charge quantization and three colours from complex octonions is striking; the standing criticism is that procedures are selected to reproduce experimental results rather than because the structure demands it -- which names exactly the failure mode our sealed two-outcome preregs, MB12 vacuity controls and B724's look-elsewhere theorem exist to prevent. We do NOT claim the algebra alone selects the SM without priced inputs. (3) CONNES: the standing criticism is that mass data sits in a finite Dirac operator that can be practically ANY self-adjoint operator, with the Lorentzian gauge Lagrangian open. That cannot be levelled at us for a reason that is also a LIMITATION -- Gate 5 means we have no Dirac operator, no Lagrangian and no mass data at all; we are not vulnerable because we do not reach there, and we explicitly do NOT claim their successes. (4) ARITHMETIC CHERN-SIMONS: our object is a genuine 3-manifold used as a source of structure, not an arithmetic analogy, and our CS invariant is 0 by amphichirality so the VOLUME analogue would be the whole question; we do NOT claim any arithmetic-CS theorem. (5) THE GENRE: its characteristic failure is a headline derivation with an unstated input; ours is the opposite and is checkable -- a kill graph of 756 records, C16's threefold no-go (NO POINT x8, NO WIDTH x3, NO NAME x2), and C17 conceding zero of 24. Our most-cited results are our negatives, and we claim NO SM parameter value, not one. SCOPE: a POSITIONING deliverable, not mathematics; Furey's and Connes' primary papers were NOT read in full, so their criticisms are reported as the standing published criticisms rather than as this seat's independent assessment. Gate 5 untouched.
